title: Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Renewal Serum

seo.title: Copper Peptide Serum 2% (GHK-Cu) | Skingenetix
seo.description: 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu) serum with vitamin C and hyaluronic acid. In a double-blind trial, GHK-Cu cut wrinkle volume 55.8% more than the serum without it.

description_html:
A high-strength daily serum built around 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) for firmer, smoother and more renewed-looking skin.

  • 2% Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) - our hero active, with the percentage stated on the pack
  • Supports firmer, smoother, more resilient-looking skin
  • No parabens · no mineral oil · no synthetic fragrance

Best for: those wanting firmer, smoother, more radiant-looking skin from a gentle daily peptide serum.
custom.key_benefits:
- Firms & smooths - supports the appearance of firmness, elasticity and a smoother texture
- Softens fine lines - helps reduce the look of fine lines and dullness
- Antioxidant defence - helps protect against the daily environmental stress that dulls skin
- Deep hydration - multi-weight hyaluronic acid for a plump, hydrated feel
What to expect: smoother, more hydrated-feeling skin within days; in the double-blind trial, GHK-Cu's wrinkle-volume result was measured after 8 weeks of twice-daily use.
custom.how_to_use:
Use morning and evening. After cleansing, press 3-4 drops onto slightly damp skin across the face and neck - pat gently, don't rub. Let it absorb for about a minute, then follow with your moisturiser. In the morning, always finish with SPF.
Tip: this serum layers well with niacinamide and stable Vitamin C. If you separately use pure L-ascorbic Vitamin C, strong acids (AHA/BHA) or high-strength retinol, apply those at a different time of day.
Complete the routine: seal it in with the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Day Gel-Cream in the morning, or the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Night Cream in the evening.
custom.clinical_research:
GHK-Cu, double-blind tested: 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the same serum without it.
GHK-Cu is a copper peptide your own body makes, first isolated from human plasma in 1973. In clinical research:
- 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the serum without it, measured by 3D skin imaging (40 women, 8 weeks)
- 7 in 10 people showed new collagen production after one month in a skin-biopsy study, vs 5 in 10 with vitamin C and 4 in 10 with tretinoin
- An independent 2026 systematic review found GHK-Cu significantly reduced wrinkle volume and depth compared with controls
Badenhorst et al. 2016, J Aging Sci (split-face, 8 weeks, funded by the tested serum's maker); Abdulghani et al. 1998; Mokhtar et al. 2026, Aesthetic Surgery Journal (two trials). Results describe the ingredient, not this product.

custom.faq_items.question: What does the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Renewal Serum do?
custom.faq_items.answer: A multi-peptide serum built around 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), with supporting peptides, stable vitamin C, niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. It supports firmer, smoother and more radiant-looking skin.

custom.faq_items.question: What is copper peptide (GHK-Cu)?
custom.faq_items.answer: A copper peptide your own body makes, first isolated from human plasma in 1973. In a double-blind trial, a GHK-Cu serum reduced wrinkle volume 55.8% more than the same serum without it, and a 2026 systematic review found GHK-Cu significantly reduced wrinkle volume and depth compared with controls. This serum contains 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu), or 20,000 ppm.

custom.faq_items.question: How and when do I use it?
custom.faq_items.answer: Use morning and/or evening on clean skin. Apply 3-4 drops to face and neck, allow about 60 seconds to absorb, then follow with your moisturiser (and SPF 30+ in the morning).

custom.faq_items.question: Can I layer it with the Copper Peptide creams?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Apply the serum first, then seal with the Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) 2% Day Gel-Cream in the morning or Night Cream in the evening for a complete copper peptide routine.

custom.faq_items.question: Can I use it with retinol or vitamin C?
custom.faq_items.answer: Yes. Peptides work well alongside other actives. Apply thinnest to thickest; if you use a separate retinol, you can alternate evenings or apply it after your serum.

custom.faq_items.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
custom.faq_items.answer: It is formulated without parabens, mineral oil or added synthetic fragrance. As with any new product, we recommend a patch test first.
